alt: 孩子做點心時慌了手腳，一手扶快倒下的碗，一手想接住滾落的雞蛋，桌上材料散亂。
scene_prompt: 手忙腳亂 means one person is flustered and disorganized while trying to do things. A modern older child wearing a simple apron attempts to bake in a safe home kitchen WITHOUT any hot stove. Child has EXACTLY TWO normal hands: left hand trying to steady a tilting mixing bowl on the counter, right hand reaching to stop a single egg rolling toward the edge. A small puff of spilled flour and a tipped empty measuring cup show confusion; worried wide-eyed expression, slightly awkward stance. Adult in background is coming to help calmly. Clear readable central action, no broken glass or cuts, no multiple ghost limbs, no dangerous heat.
